about: The Countdown Timer is a versatile online timer that counts down from a specified time to zero. Perfect for productivity sessions, cooking, workouts, presentations, or any activity that requires precise time tracking.
Features customizable time settings, visual and audio alerts, and can run in the background while you work on other tasks. The timer continues running even if you switch browser tabs.
howToUse: Set your desired countdown time (hours, minutes, seconds)
Click start to begin the countdown
Monitor progress with the visual display

faqs.question: Does the timer work in the background?
faqs.answer: Yes, the countdown timer continues running even when you switch to other browser tabs or minimize the window.

faqs.question: Can I customize the alert sound?
faqs.answer: The timer includes built-in alert sounds. You can enable or disable audio notifications based on your preference.

faqs.question: What's the maximum countdown time?
faqs.answer: You can set countdowns up to 24 hours, making it suitable for long-duration activities and events.

faqs.question: Will the timer reset if I refresh the page?
faqs.answer: Yes, refreshing the page will reset the timer. Make sure to complete your countdown session before closing or refreshing.
